\node[card,below=1.5cm of b] (c) {\heading{3}{冪零idealを用いた有限基底変換}{A finite basis change over a nilpotent ideal}$\mathfrak a^{3(p-1)+1}=0$, $Q^{-1}EQ=\operatorname{diag}(I_{d_0},0)$.\\$d=d_0|T_\theta|$, $w=s_\theta|T_\theta|$, $wd_0=s_\theta d$ \Tx{（整数等式）}{(integer identities)}.};
